description: This file defines a custom exception class PermissionNotFoundException used when a permission resource is not found in the system. It extends the AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException from the core infrastructure.

classes.name: PermissionNotFoundException
classes.description: A RuntimeException indicating that a permission resource was not found, with a constructor that takes a permission code.

methods.name: PermissionNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new exception instance with a message indicating the permission code does not exist.
